info.longName: iShares Paris-Aligned Climate Optimized MSCI USA ETF

funds_data.description: The underlying index is composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization stocks that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
